subject: Next steps: CloudVista marketplace discovery & technical slotting
messages:
From: Alicia Murray <amurray@cloudvista.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Cc: partner-success@cloudvista.io
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + next step coordination (marketplace discovery)

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — really helpful to understand Redwood's hosted/dedicated/private lineup and the marketplace flow. A few notes from our side:

- Primary use case: enable our reseller partners to list and provision Redwood Dedicated offerings from the CloudVista marketplace (billing integration + SSO).
- Key concerns: deployment templates, audit logs/SOC2 artifacts, and pilot pricing.
- Technical owners: myself (program lead) and our platform engineer, Miguel Santos (cc'd on partner-success).

We'd like to move to a short technical deep dive with your infra/marketplace engineer to validate connect patterns (VPC/SCIM/billing hook). Are you able to propose 2–3 slots next week? Our preference is PST mornings.

Also attaching a short intake PDF that captures basic environment and stakeholders. If you can share a rough agenda for the deep dive, that would be great.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Murray
Partnerships, CloudVista
Alicia.murray@cloudvista.io

Attachment: cloudvista-intake-form.pdf (1 page PDF)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
To: Alicia Murray <amurray@cloudvista.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.example.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next step coordination (marketplace discovery)

Hi Alicia —

Great to meet earlier, and thanks for the intake form — helpful. Quick recap from Redwood:

- Proposed scope for the technical deep dive: networking/registration (VPC & peering patterns), SSO/SCIM for partner-managed accounts, billing hook integration for marketplace provisioning, and an initial rollout plan (pilot).
- Internal owners: Camila (marketplace integrations) will lead the technical session; Vanessa will cover commercial/pilot terms and SLAs.

Availability next week (all PST mornings):
- Tue 2025-12-09, 09:30–10:15
- Wed 2025-12-10, 08:30–09:15
- Thu 2025-12-11, 10:00–10:45

If none of those work, propose a handful of windows that match your team's mornings and we'll adapt.

Agenda (proposed, 45 minutes):
1) 5m intros & objectives
2) 15m infra/connect patterns (Camila)
3) 10m provisioning & billing workflow (Vanessa)
4) 10m security/compliance artifacts & next steps
5) 5m action items and owners

I'll also drop the HubSpot deal link and a short Redwood marketplace playbook for your review.

Best,
Sean
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765
Attachment: redwood-marketplace-playbook.pdf (4 pages)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next step coordination (marketplace discovery)

Hi Alicia —

Camila here. Happy to lead the technical deep dive. A couple of prep asks to make the session efficient:

1) Can Miguel (or another platform engineer) join the call? We may need their CIDR & VPC topology.
2) If you can mark any compliance documents you want pre-shared (SOC2, retention policy), we can pull those into the call doc.

Also — if your team could complete the intake form fields on page 1 (network ranges, expected pilot throughput, provisioning cadence), that will help me scope the demo artifacts to bring (diagram + short playbook).

If the Tue/Wed/Thu slots Sean suggested work, I'll block the first available and share a calendar invite. Otherwise, propose two alternatives.

Cheers,
Camila
Marketplace Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.example.com

Thanks all — Tue 2025-12-09 at 09:30 PST works for Miguel and me. Miguel will join and can share a brief network slide.

Pre-call asks:
- Please share SOC2 scope and the retention policy doc if possible.
- We would like a 10-minute walkthrough of the billing hook prototype (what webhook fields we should expect).

I'll accept the invite once it's in the calendar and will populate the intake form page 1 with CIDR and expected pilot throughput by EOD Friday.

—Alicia
